title: Concatenation of anchor-free runs
statement: Let $M$ be a multi-tape Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, let $a$ be a control state, and let $c$ be a configuration. If the run from $c$ avoids state $a$ at every time from $0$ through $u$, and the run from the configuration reached at time $u$ avoids $a$ at every time from $0$ through $v$, then the run from $c$ avoids $a$ at every time from $0$ through $u+v$.
hypotheses_covered: the run from $c$ avoids $a$ at times $0$ through $u$
the run continued from time $u$ avoids $a$ at times $0$ through $v$
replaced:
If the run from $c$ is anchor-free for $u$ steps and the run continued from
its configuration at time $u$ is anchor-free for $v$ further steps, then the
run from $c$ is anchor-free for $u + v$ steps.
